title: Quick Prostate Cancer Test
summary: Warning signs, hidden risk factors and prostate-test facts in one quick awareness challenge.

landing.intro: Some prostate changes are easy to dismiss as ageing. See if you can identify the warning signs and hidden risk clues across 10 quick questions.

about.body:
This ten-question awareness challenge covers prostate anatomy, possible warning signs, risk factors and common parts of the diagnostic pathway. It measures what you know, not your symptoms, personal risk or health.

Prostate cancer may cause no symptoms at first, and urinary changes often have non-cancerous causes. New, persistent or worsening changes—including trouble urinating or blood in urine or semen—should be discussed with a qualified healthcare professional.

howToPlay.title: How to Play
steps: Answer ten questions about prostate signs, risk and testing.
Choose the most accurate answer without overthinking it.
Reveal your awareness score, then unlock every answer you missed.

about.disclaimer: For entertainment and general learning only. This is not a symptom checker, risk calculator, PSA test, medical screening tool or diagnosis. It cannot confirm or rule out prostate cancer or any other condition. Seek prompt medical care for severe pain, inability to urinate, heavy bleeding or rapidly worsening symptoms.

answers: Below the bladder, around part of the urethra
